subject: Future Tech
title: Intellectual Property Challenges
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Intellectual Property Challenges.

hook.text: If you can 3D-scan any object and print a copy, who owns the design?

buildup.text: Thingiverse hosts millions of free 3D models. Many are original, but some are scans of patented or copyrighted products.

discovery.text: The music industry fought piracy with lawsuits and DRM.

twist.text: Some companies embrace it. Lego fans print custom bricks. Lego hasn't sued them but hasn't endorsed them either.

climax.text: New digital rights management for 3D files and blockchain-tracked designs are emerging but adoption is slow.

punchline.text: When anyone can print anything, ownership gets complicated.

quiz.question: What platform hosts millions of free 3D-printable models?
